title: Add FolderSetupView
description: Create CookbookApp/FolderSetupView.swift as a centered VStack layout shown full-screen when no folder is configured. Contains: folder.badge.questionmark SF Symbol at large size; title 'Please select a folder with recipes' (.title2 typography); subtitle 'Cookbook reads recipes from a folder you pick — on your device, in iCloud Drive, or any provider you have set up.' (.body, .foregroundStyle(.secondary)); a .borderedProminent Button('Choose folder…') that presents RecipesFolderPicker. Accessibility label on the button.
acceptance_criteria: Centered layout with icon, title, subtitle, and button in a VStack
Icon: folder.badge.questionmark SF Symbol at large display size
Title text matches spec exactly with .title2 typography
Subtitle text matches spec exactly with .body and .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
After successful selection, AppRoot re-evaluates and transitions to tab shell on next render
Explicit .accessibilityLabel on the Choose folder button
